description: A local, read-only USB bridge for retrieving DevonCraft screenshots from a TI-Nspire, including while the game is running.

defaultPrompt: Connect my TI-Nspire and retrieve the latest DevonCraft screenshot.
Check which DevonCraft screenshots are saved on my calculator.
Help me troubleshoot the local TI-Nspire USB connection safely.
interface.longDescription: A local, read-only USB bridge for supported TI-Nspire calculators. It retrieves DevonCraft PPM screenshots over the standard file-transfer service (0x4060), including while the game remains open after Ctrl + Shift + Period enables the temporary in-game USB transfer window. It never sends the live screen-capture command (0x4024). A compatible local MCP host and USB access on the computer connected to the calculator are required.

name: devoncraft-usb-bridge
